overview: The project team presented six narrowed-down design options for the Medford High School project, ranging from code upgrades to new construction. The forum addressed site-specific challenges, including a 1967 deed restriction and the potential need for modular classrooms during the construction phase.

items.title: Review of Six Design Options
items.summary: Architect Matt Rice detailed six remaining options: a code upgrade (A.1), three addition-renovation variations (B.1.2, C2.2, C3.4), and two new construction designs (D1.1, D2.1).

items.title: Site Constraints and Deed Restriction
items.summary: The project team disclosed a 1967 deed restriction on the property and stated they are coordinating with the Department of Conservation and Recreation to assess its impact on the proposed designs.

items.title: Construction Phasing and Modular Classrooms
items.summary: The team explained that while most options have been updated to avoid modular classrooms, the code upgrade (A.1) and one addition-renovation option (B1.2) would still require them.

items.title: Cost Estimates and Project Timeline
items.summary: Updated cost estimates are scheduled to be presented to the building committee on May 20th following community requests for more detailed financial data before narrowing the options further.
